name: koralpaper
description: Let Claude design diagrams directly on your KoralPaper paper.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the KoralPaper app running in your browser. Describe a diagram in plain words and Claude draws it as fully editable hand-drawn-style elements: flowcharts, carousels, decision trees. Claude can also read the current page, look at a rendered picture of it, and tidy or restyle what is already there. Nothing leaves your machine except your conversation with Claude.
